# ideaShell memory video — overseas (English) posting kit

| File | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `ideashell-memory-en.mp4` | 32s, 1080×1920, 30 fps, music + SFX, no voice-over, -13.6 LUFS |
| `cover-en-9x16.png` | TikTok / Reels / Shorts cover (key art sits in the centre 3:4 band, so the profile-grid crop keeps it) |
| `cover-en-3x4.png` | Instagram feed / profile-grid cover, Pinterest |

The frame is already laid out for short-video UI: content is scaled to 84% and lifted 30px, so the right-side
like/comment/share rail and the bottom caption block don't cover any text.

## Copy

Pick one hook per post and A/B the first two. Keep the on-screen text and caption saying different things.

**TikTok**

> Forgot what the client said 11 months ago? It didn't. 🧠
>
> Ask your notes, calls and files like you'd ask a coworker — and get the answer with the source.
>
> #productivity #notetaking #AItools #worksmarter #secondbrain #meetingnotes

**Instagram Reels**

> You forgot. It remembers.
>
> ideaShell turns 1,000 scattered notes, call recordings, PDFs and spreadsheets into one memory you can ask
> anything — "What was Mark's budget again?" → "$120K, from your Nov 12 call."
>
> Save this for your next client renewal.
>
> #productivity #AIapps #notetaking #secondbrain #knowledgework #workflow

**YouTube Shorts**

- Title: `Your notes finally answer back #shorts`
- Description: `Ask a question, get the answer with its source — across notes, call recordings, contracts and spreadsheets. ideaShell: remember more, think better.`

**X / LinkedIn (with the 3:4 cover or the video)**

> Most notes get written once and never read again.
>
> We built ideaShell so you can just ask: budgets from last year's call, the breach clause on page 47 of an
> 86-page contract, which of three vendor quotes is cheapest.
>
> Remember more. Think better.

## Before you publish

- Add the store link or "link in bio" yourself — the video makes no availability or pricing claims on purpose.
- Pin a first comment with one concrete use case (e.g. "Prep me for Mark's renewal call").
- Post with original audio as is; trending sounds will clash with the SFX timing.
